ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (9) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Добро» (dobro, 'good') is the title and is kept distinct from «благо» (blago, 'the good'); «разуметь / разумение» (razumet' / razumenie, 'to understand / understanding') is 'understand / understanding', and «непротивление злому» (neprotivlenie zlomu, 'non-resistance to evil') is held constant. The Gospel sayings, including the paraphrase of John 1:51 and the lowercase «сын божий» (syn bozhiy, 'son of God'), are translated from the Russian as printed.
